evidence.scope: Five parser/header findings; historical original/staged before/after equality.

definitions.direct_source_dependency: An original criterion explicitly names the defective source, or the original prompt assigns task-specific content/material to that source and the criterion tests that content. Dependence does not mean the source is exclusive, all its content is inaccessible, or the criterion is failed.
definitions.conditional_source_route: The source is one allowed route or its use is conditional. Preserve the alternative/condition; do not turn it into a mandatory source dependency.
definitions.potential_indirect_effect: The defect may affect the requested construction or evidence chain, but the original criterion can be evaluated using an output or other sources. Actual effect remains unknown.
definitions.remainder_unknown: Not analyzed further for this source defect; not cleared, failed, or excluded.
definitions.source_input_status: Unconfirmed impact on task completion/evaluation, separate from the established file-format fact and separate from baseline content feasibility.
definitions.fallback_available: Specific body text is readable from raw XML on a working copy; this does not prove native DOCX semantics, a complete content read, or participant capability.
definitions.missing_wav_tail: Bytes declared by the PCM data chunk are absent from the exact source object. Rewriting metadata cannot recover original absent samples.

content_feasibility_separation.disposition: This supplemental source-input uncertainty record does not edit the requirements review, frozen source, original rubric items, or inspection protocols. The controller may connect it to the ledger while retaining unresolved source conditions.

original_criteria.criterion: The Master track is tightly synchronized to the provided DRUM REFERENCE TRACK.wav with initial start-offset ≤ 10 ms when both start at t=0 (48 kHz).
If deliverable incorporated samples, Samples stem is tightly synchronized to DRUM REFERENCE TRACK.wav with initial start-offset ≤ 10 ms at t=0.

dependency_groups.basis: These criteria explicitly compare the initial offset with the supplied drum reference; index 24 applies only when samples were incorporated.
dependency_groups.impact: The beginning is inside the available approximately 116.508-second PCM payload. Tail truncation alone does not remove initial-offset evidence. No synchronization check or auditory inspection was performed.

original_criteria.criterion: The Master track exhibits end-to-end drift ≤ 10 ms relative to DRUM REFERENCE TRACK.wav over the full duration.
If deliverable incorporated samples, Samples stem exhibits end-to-end drift ≤ 10 ms relative to DRUM REFERENCE TRACK.wav over the full duration.

dependency_groups.basis: These criteria explicitly require end-to-end drift relative to the reference over the full duration; index 25 applies only when samples were incorporated.
dependency_groups.impact: The declared PCM duration is approximately 137.143 seconds, but only approximately 116.508 seconds of payload is present. A full-length source-relative drift conclusion is unconfirmed because the final approximately 20.635 seconds is absent.

original_criteria.criterion: The drum content in the Master track matches the provided DRUM REFERENCE TRACK.wav when aligned (e.g., cross-correlation peak at lag ≤ 10 ms with high similarity).

dependency_groups.basis: This criterion explicitly compares drum content in the Master with the supplied drum reference.
dependency_groups.impact: The available head can support a partial comparison; it cannot establish equivalence to absent tail audio. The intended comparison extent and any treatment of the truncated source remain unconfirmed.

original_criteria.criterion: The Master track tempo is 140 BPM (± 1 BPM), verified by alignment to the provided drum reference or tempo analysis.

dependency_groups.basis: The criterion permits either reference alignment or tempo analysis.
dependency_groups.impact: A reference-alignment route inherits the source limit. Output tempo analysis is an explicit alternative; this defect does not establish failure of the tempo criterion.

prompt_level_obligations.prompt_excerpt: The instrumental track should be 140 bpm, and all instrumentation should be tightly synchronized to the Drum track provided.
prompt_level_obligations.impact: Using the supplied drums across the requested approximately 2:17 Master requires an explicit treatment of unavailable tail data. Header repair or padding cannot recover the original missing samples; this record does not choose a substitute or judge an output.

remainder_unknown.meaning: No direct dependence conclusion is made for these criteria in this bounded mapping. They are neither cleared nor failed; task outputs and other evidence have not been evaluated.

original_criteria.criterion: Every timestamp labeled as string noise/click/pop in Bass Edit Spots.docx is silenced without changing total length of the bass

dependency_groups.basis: The prompt requires editing the supplied raw bass; these criteria assess silence replacement without changing bass length and local edit-boundary cleanliness.
dependency_groups.impact: All listed edit positions lie in the available head. Local audio quality and edit success remain untested. For the length-preservation part of index 12, the complete declared 204-second source payload is unavailable.

dependency_groups.basis: The requested final mix combines edited bass with the other supplied stems while preserving their lengths and the Rough Mix character. These criteria assess the resulting full mix, including length, alignment, guitar balance, stereo image, loudness, and timing artifacts.

The complete Rough Mix and other supplied stems provide additional evidence; their use does not automatically establish equivalence to missing isolated samples. These output criteria do not directly require a valid original WAV header and are not automatically failed.

original_criteria.criterion: At least one oil‑market citation is drawn from a source listed in the Reference File "Research Material.docx" and includes a working URL.
At least one natural‑gas‑market citation is drawn from a source listed in the Reference File "Research Material.docx" and includes a working URL.

dependency_groups.basis: These criteria explicitly require at least one oil and one natural-gas citation from the source list in Research Material.docx.

Read-only access to word/document.xml exposes all nine source-name/literal-URL entries, so the list is available through raw XML on a scratch copy. Working URLs, current public access, relevant data, and actual citations remain unverified.

paragraphs.text: Reference MaterialTo prepare your report, you'll need to leverage publicly available energy market data and research databases from the following industry publications. Note that you should only use publicly available data from these sources that do not require going behind paywalls, as this public information is sufficient to successfully complete the task.

original_criteria.criterion: Oil market overview includes at least one quantitative datapoint (e.g., price range, supply/demand, inventory, or production) with a working citation URL.
Natural gas market overview includes at least one quantitative datapoint (e.g., price, storage levels, production, exports) with a working citation URL.
All cited sources used in the report are publicly accessible without login or paywall.
Each citation includes a publication date or an access date alongside the URL.

dependency_groups.basis: These criteria concern quantitative oil/gas citations, public accessibility, and citation dates. The prompt directs the report to the attached public-source leads.
dependency_groups.impact: The malformed relationships do not by themselves establish a lack of working public data: source names and literal URLs are readable. No network research or access/date validation was performed, so downstream effect remains unknown.

prompt_level_obligations.impact: Use of the source list can proceed through the observed body-XML fallback. This is a limited reading route, not a repair of the original DOCX, a native application compatibility proof, or evidence that its external resources are accessible.
